article.headline: Davis scores 15, Creighton takes down Bethune-Cookman 88-65
article.description: — B.J. Davis' 15 points helped Creighton defeat Bethune-Cookman 88-65 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Davis scores 15, Creighton takes down Bethune-Cookman 88-65
article.story: OMAHA, Neb. -- — B.J. Davis' 15 points helped Creighton defeat Bethune-Cookman 88-65 on Wednesday. Davis also contributed six rebounds and three steals for the Bluejays (4-1). Hudson Greer scored 14 points and added five rebounds. Fredrick King shot 4 of 5 from the field and 3 for 4 from the line to finish with 11 points. Daniel Rouzan led the Wildcats (0-5) in scoring, finishing with 12 points. Bethune-Cookman also got 10 points and three steals from Jameel Morris. Creighton took the lead with 14:19 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Davis led in scoring with 11 points in the first half to help put Creighton up 38-31 at the break. Creighton pulled away with a 9-0 run in the second half to extend a seven-point lead to 16 points. The Bluejays outscored Bethune-Cookman by 16 points in the final half, as Jackson McAndrew led the way with a team-high eight second-half points. Up next Up next for Creighton is a Tuesday matchup with Michigan, and Bethune-Cookman visits Richmond on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
